svg.title: Online softmax step by step
svg.text: FlashAttentionKernel's online softmax: prompt row 140, head 2, key tiles of 64
Layer 1 of Mei's chat (156 tokens) as one prompt. Block (head 2, blockIdx.y 2) holds rows 128–155; last_key = 155.
Row 140 is warp 0's row_hi for lanes 16–19: each holds 16 of the tile's 64 scores; two __shfl_xor_sync combine their max and sum.
Scores are s · scale_log2 (scale_log2 = log2(e) / √128), so exp2 replaces e^x. Q, K, V, P in FP16, sums in FP32.
exact: CausalAttention in FP32. Bars: one score per key, same scale in every tile; dashed: the running max after the tile.
load the tile's keys and values; keys past last_key reload key last_key
mask keys past the row's position to −∞, take the tile max across the 4 lanes
new running max; shrink = exp2(old max − new max)
P = exp2(s − max); sum = sum · shrink + tile sum; o *= shrink
o += P · V on tensor cores, P rounded to FP16
after the last tile: divide o by the sum and write the row
